profile.role_note: HP-scaling Fusion heavy-attack carry; converts HP into ATK and Fusion DMG.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: A strong HP-scaling Fusion heavy-attack carry and F2P-friendly pick; worth pulling if you have Iuno or Lupa, but reaching 50K HP without his signature is demanding.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Thousandfold Deliverance + 5-piece Lamp of Nether Road in a 4-4-1-1-1 layout (two Crit 4-costs) with Myriad Snare: Rustfire Chassis in the main slot. Aim for ~50,000 HP, balanced Crit, and 125% Energy Regen; without the signature, a 4-1-1-1-1 setup with a strong Crit weapon is the fallback.

ranked_weapons.name: Thousandfold Deliverance
ranked_weapons.note: His signature and the only weapon that makes 50K HP reachable. 72.2% HP substat, All-Attribute DMG, and Heavy Attack DMG buffs.

ranked_weapons.name: Thunderflare Dominion
ranked_weapons.note: High base ATK, Crit Rate, and Heavy Attack DMG buffs; the best non-signature 5-star.

ranked_weapons.name: Verdant Summit
ranked_weapons.note: High ATK, Crit DMG, and stackable Heavy Attack DMG on Intro/Liberation.

ranked_weapons.name: Aureate Zenith
ranked_weapons.note: Battle-pass 4-star; Crit DMG substat with ATK and Heavy Attack buffs on Liberation.

ranked_weapons.name: Autumntrace
ranked_weapons.note: Battle-pass 4-star; Crit Rate substat with stacking ATK on Heavy Attack DMG.

ranked_weapons.name: Helios Cleaver
ranked_weapons.note: ATK% substat with stacking ATK on Resonance Skill; usable filler.

echo_sets.name: Lamp of Nether Road
echo_sets.note: Made for him: 2-pc HP%, 5-pc stacking Crit Rate on shield gain plus Fusion DMG at max stacks. Myriad Snare adds Fusion and Heavy Attack DMG.

echo_sets.name: Crown of Valor + Lamp of Nether Road
echo_sets.note: Stackable ATK and Crit DMG on shield generation with 2-pc HP%; viable second-best.

stat_priorities.note: Two Crit 4-costs in the 4-4-1-1-1 layout. Without the signature, swap one 4-cost for a 1-cost HP% echo (4-1-1-1-1) to chase 50K HP.
HP% on all three 1-costs; every 1,000 HP above 25,000 unlocks his multipliers, up to 50,000 HP.

teams.name: Premium: Jingran + Lynae + Mornye

members.name: Jingran
members.note: HP-scaling heavy-attack carry; opens a Mono Fusion variant with Lupa and Mornye.

members.name: Lynae
members.note: All-DMG and Resonance Liberation amplification for Jingran's burst windows.

members.name: Mornye
members.note: General All-DMG buffs, faster Off-Tune Tune Breaks, and sustain.

teams.rotation: Mornye opens with her field-observation combo into Liberation and Outro, Lynae runs her buff window, then Jingran enters via Intro: Liberation into enhanced Heavy Attack loops, swapping back to Mornye at full Concerto.

teams.name: Alternative: Jingran + Iuno + Shorekeeper

members.name: Jingran
members.note: Benefits from Iuno's shields and Heavy Attack buffs; very natural pairing.

members.name: Iuno
members.note: Shields plus Heavy Attack DMG amplification; her buffs feed directly into his damage type.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Healing and Crit support; her kit fits shield-centric teams well.

teams.rotation: Shorekeeper deploys Stellarealm, Iuno runs her Lunar Cycle for shields and Heavy Attack buffs, then Jingran takes an extended on-field window of Liberation into enhanced Heavy Attacks.

tier_badge.label: Meta-defining
tier_badge.note: Premier Fusion Heavy Attack hypercarry; anchors a top meta team.
